{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data for missing values, duplicates, and distributions
print("Missing values:")
print(data.isnull().sum())

print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(data.duplicated().sum())

print("\nValue counts for key variables:")
print(data['arm'].value_counts())
print(data['severity'].value_counts())
print(data['sex'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker columns
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:")
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().head())

print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_final:")
print(data['biomarker_final'].value_counts().head())

# Check for implausible values (e.g., negative biomarker baseline)
print("\nNegative biomarker_baseline values:")
print(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] < 0]['biomarker_baseline'].count())

# Check for implausible values in biomarker_final
print("\nNegative biomarker_final values:")
print(data[data['biomarker_final'] < 0]['biomarker_final'].count())"}
